source_book: Modern GPU Programming For MLSys (MLC Community) + NVIDIA Blackwell Tuning/Compatibility Guides

test_cases.prompt: Design TMA loads + PIPE_DEPTH=2 for my B200 GEMM.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Should activate and provide the descriptor, barriers, stage ring, and three-phase timeline.
test_cases.notes: Used to validate activation boundaries and execution method; does not mean it has been run on B200 hardware.

test_cases.prompt: After a TMA store, when can Dsmem be reused?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Should activate and explain the commit/wait group drain protocol.
test_cases.notes: Used to validate activation boundaries and execution method; does not mean it has been run on B200 hardware.

test_cases.prompt: How does this 3D tile get both tiling and a 128B swizzle at the same time?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Should activate and design the descriptor dimensions and the matching layout.
test_cases.notes: Used to validate activation boundaries and execution method; does not mean it has been run on B200 hardware.

test_cases.prompt: I need a random-index gather where every lane has a different address.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Should not default to TMA; should suggest a plain/vectorized thread path.
test_cases.notes: Used to validate activation boundaries and execution method; does not mean it has been run on B200 hardware.

test_cases.prompt: Help me investigate CPU memcpy performance.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Should not activate; not GPU TMA.
test_cases.notes: Used to validate activation boundaries and execution method; does not mean it has been run on B200 hardware.

test_cases.prompt: The tile is only 1KB but it loops many times — is TMA worth it?
test_cases.expected_behavior: May be invoked for a cost/overlap assessment, but must not outright guarantee that TMA is faster.
test_cases.notes: Used to validate activation boundaries and execution method; does not mean it has been run on B200 hardware.

notes: All should_not_trigger cases must pass; edge_case must state the invocation boundary. These tests are prompt/behavior stress tests, not hardware performance tests.
